summary: #128145 remains a canonical, narrow bug on main: configured ACP bindings carry the owner model but omit its thinking default before ACPX starts the session. Implementation is blocked in this read-only checkout because acpx 0.13.1 source/types and ../codex are absent, and dependencies cannot be installed.

actions.reason: A focused fix should carry the owner-resolved thinking default through the configured-binding spec, persistent metadata, and ACP runtime options, then translate it through the verified ACPX 0.13.1 session-option contract without adding configuration.
Do not implement against an inferred upstream field. Resume in a writable checkout after directly inspecting acpx 0.13.1 source/types and the required sibling Codex source.
